## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `93c631a4721db7f720c1004041d28f2fee97d68e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: ruled

Inputs read: card #35905 body and all eight comments (ordering record 7046610679, triage 7047821164, claims 7070481871 and 7075352735, pointer 7070917189, seat reading 7071003039, dev reports 7075339191 and 7075378218); PR #36345 body, file list and net diff against `main`; the check-runs on the head; ruling record 6184799323 (cited by the PR as the raise authority). Cited files were read at the head with `git show`; nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- File list is exactly two files, +6 / -5: `references/project-forms.md` (+5 / -4) and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (+1 / -1). Right: it equals the claimed file surface in claim 7075352735, and `main` has not moved either file since the merge-base `99fbaa6d`.
- No public surface, no package, no schema, no accept-set: both files are internal fleet tooling and publish nothing. Right.
- Byte arithmetic, measured from the tree and not from the PR body: the file is 4669 bytes on `main` and 4889 at the head; the two added lines are 125 and 143 bytes with their newlines (268); the cuts are 32 + 13 + 3 = 48; 268 - 48 = 220; the `CEILINGS` row moves 4669 to 4889, exactly +220, headroom 0. Right.
- Only the one `CEILINGS` row changes in the script; no other row, no header text, no logic. Right.
- Check-runs on the head: every run is `success` or `skipped`, none failed or pending; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (which carries the ratchet) are `success`.
- Rule-change declaration. The PR body declares `Rule-change: ruled` with one `Ruling-ref:` line naming record 7046610679. That record quotes the maintainer's answer 「同意，立卡派发」 to a proposal of three lines, which the card body spells as items 1 to 3. The two rule hunks were checked against items 1 and 3 clause by clause (see ④): each clause of the new text has its clause in the ruled item and no clause is added. The remaining hunks (two cuts, one un-wrap, one ceiling row) are slimming and a script row; each cut fact was found at its stated home at the head, so no rule is removed. Hence `ruled`. Limit of this check: the maintainer's words are read from the seat's transcription on the card, the fleet's ruling-record form; the project thread itself is not a GitHub input and was not read.

### ② Semver level

Nothing publishes: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` are outside every package. The PR carries `skip-changeset` and `Check Changeset` is `success`. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right; no changeset is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report 7075378218 has an empty `open_questions`. The earlier blocked report 7075339191 asked how the claim for this branch is supplied; answered by seat claim 7075352735 (option A), and `PR-body guards` is green on the head.
- Deviation "edits pushed before the claim mismatch was noticed": no other actor's state changed, and the claim now names this branch. Accepted.
- Deviation "row comment names the two ruling records": matches the form of the other raised rows, and ids live in the script, not in skill text, so `filing-gate.md` (no card numbers, comment ids or dated quotes in skill text) is kept. Accepted.
- The ordering record's last sentence, "It orders no byte-ceiling raise", sits under "Reading taken by the seat". Judged: it is a seat's observation about the maintainer's words, not his refusal. Ruling 6184799323 item 1 makes a ruling of record that orders text into a ratcheted file the authorization for the measured raise with "No second word from the maintainer", item 5 puts that in force for every ruling of record, and the `SKILL.md` guard-index row for the ratchet says the same. The card's own constraint (compress first; if it cannot fit, stop and tell the seat the file and the shortfall) was followed: 48 bytes were cut first, the shortfall was reported (7070917189) and the seat read it (7071003039). The raise is authorized and is not beyond the measured delta.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no query code in the diff.
- Security: no hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`references/project-forms.md`, against items 1 and 3 of the card and the neighbouring rules at the head:

- New line 30 against item 1. "项目记忆只存维护者原话(带时间)与技能指针" is "holds only the maintainer's words with their time, and pointers into the skill"; "⛔ 不复述规则" is "never restates a rule"; "与技能相左 ⇒ 照技能,删该行" is "a memory line that disagrees with the skill: follow the skill and delete the line". Complete, nothing added. It sits directly under the memory-is-a-cache line, the place the card names.
- New line 31 against item 3. "维护者裁决与技能相左 ⇒ 当日立技能卡" is "a ruling that disagrees with the skill gets a skill card the same day"; "记忆行点名它,合并即删" is "the memory line names that card and is deleted when it merges"; "技能 PR 合并 ⇒ 协调者照改动行查记忆" is "when a skill PR merges, the coordinator reviews memory against the changed lines". Complete, nothing added.
- No restatement: a search of `.claude/**` and `AGENTS.md` at the head finds no other line carrying either rule. Item 2 (a dispatch order missing its derivation is sent back) is not in this diff and is not restated here.
- No contradiction found with the neighbours. `filing-gate.md` keeps current values (freeze, pause, focus, concurrency) in the seat post and project memory, and `area-lease.md` keeps the per-container dev cap there: those are values the maintainer set, held as his words, not rules restated. `coordinator.md` keeps the ruling record on the card and never in memory: line 31 agrees, the record goes on a skill card and the memory line only names it. `filing-gate.md` also requires a standing rule to be ordered as such: the quoted answer agrees to a proposal to add the lines to the skill text, which is not temporary and not addressed to one seat.
- Cut "(车道、总监、分诊同此)": line 6 of the same file still says lane, director and triage seats are all seats, and line 20 keeps the seat reading for "the project's seat" without exception. No fact lost.
- Cut ",含在飞卡": `seat-lifecycle.md` line 26 states that the forced takeover order takes the seat, the queue, in-flight cards, unstarted cards and PRs awaiting landing. The fact has a wider home; the takeover rule is unchanged.
- Un-wrap of the queue-flake continuation: no text deleted, 3 bytes freed, as the ratchet header describes for an un-wrap. The 200-byte figure on line 38 governs mailbox comments, not this file.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, against the ratchet's own discipline: the header requires a raise to quote the ordering ruling's id and the measured byte delta in the PR body and to move the row in the same PR by at most that delta. The PR body quotes 7046610679 and +220; the row moves by exactly 220; the file measures 4889 at the head. The code and the contract agree.

Attempts to break it, and what they left:

- N1 (nit) — lines 30 and 31 read together: line 30 deletes a memory line that disagrees with the skill, while line 31 keeps the memory line of a disagreeing maintainer ruling until the skill PR merges. Read as general rule and specific case it is coherent, and that is how the ruled items themselves stand, so the copy is faithful; rewording would go beyond the ruling. Left as ruled. If a seat is ever seen deleting a ruling's line early, that is a card for the maintainer, not a fix here.
- N2 (nit) — "只存" in line 30 is absolute, while `filing-gate.md` and `area-lease.md` send current values to project memory. Consistent only on the reading that a current value is stored as the maintainer's words with their time. The ruled item uses the same absolute, so no edit; accepted deviation.
- N3 (nit) — the comment above `CEILINGS` still says three rows were raised by a ruled raise; this is the eighth. The drift is already on `main`, the sentence is outside the changed row, and the dev left it under the order's fence. Follow-up at most; no effect on the gate.

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:车队调度技能的项目表单文件加两行:项目记忆只存维护者原话和现值,不复述规则;与技能不一致的裁定当天立技能卡,技能 PR 合并前记忆里那行先留着。
- 为什么做:落实你的原话「同意，立卡派发」(裁决记录 7046610679),起因是协调者曾按项目记忆而不是技能办事。
- 出错会怎样:只影响调度代理写项目记忆的方式,不碰产品代码;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。这是 Tier S,合同审查 PASS 后由席位入队。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。两行逐条对应卡上第 1、3 项,没有多写;为腾位删的两处说法在别处仍有原出处。

## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36345` CLEAN;draft、base `main`、`Fixes #35905`;2 个文件 +6 −5;`skip-changeset` 正确,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`。
- 前提实测:`check-governed-merges --pr 36345` 读到 `.claude/**` 声明拆分为 Tier S(正文 `Rule-change: ruled`,本 head 记录 `Rule-change-verified: ruled`);上限行 4669 → 4889(+220),审查按两个 blob 实测增 268、删 48,恰为 +220,其余行未动;提额依据裁定 6184799323 第 1 项(席位读数 7071003039)。
- 门禁 check-runs @ `93c631a4721db7f720c1004041d28f2fee97d68e`:26 success · 21 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending。
- 接受的偏差:合同审查 7075578484 的 N1(第 30 行删记忆行、第 31 行留到技能 PR 合并,两条张力同出于裁定原文)、N2(「只存」为绝对说法,与现值入记忆的规则一致需按原话加时间读)、N3(`CEILINGS` 上方注释仍说提额三行,main 上已有的漂移)均作接受的偏差,不改。
- 范围外去向:N3 注释漂移在 main 上、不在本 PR 改动行内,留待下次改该文件上限的 PR 顺带。
- 落地条款:Tier S。L2 记录 7075578484 PASS,无 must-fix/should-fix ⇒ ready + auto-merge。
